meta.description: Lab: Graphics Rendering Testbed for Hono JSX Systematically tests every category of non-ASCII symbol used across the TradingAgents dashboard. Each category shows: - BROKEN: raw \uXXXX in JSX text (renders literally) - WORKING: literal character in JSX text - WORKING: JS expression {"\uXXXX"} - WORKING: HTML entity WHY THIS MATTERS: In Hono JSX, text between tags is emitted as literal HTML. JS string escape sequences (\u00a3, \u2192, etc.) are NOT interpreted. They are emitted as six-character strings: \ u 0 0 a 3. Only inside { } expressions does JS string processing occur. Visit: /lab/currency
